notes.title: Cozy Job Simulators - Nora: The Wannabe Alchemist & Susan's Potion Workshop ✨
notes.content: [h2][b]Good day to you, Witches and Wizards[/b][/h2][hr][/hr][p]Do you have your ladles, vials, and cauldrons ready to go? We sure hope so, because today we step into the magical world of potion making, where every task is both engaging and wonderfully relaxing. Whether you’re carefully brewing mystical mixtures or experimenting with new recipes, your work as an aspiring witch takes place in a cozy, inviting environment with a gorgeous graphical style that brings the fairy-tale world to life.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41780393/0cb9c499694787f66ca1c216b45cdd0a84474a08.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Nora: The Wannabe Alchemist & Susan's Potion Workshop are part of Cozy Job Simulators 🌟[/h2][hr][/hr][p]The Cozy Jobs Simulator Event brings together a collection of relaxing and heartwarming titles that let you hone your job skills in a calm, stress-free environment. If you love unwinding with games that make everyday tasks feel magical, this event is a great opportunity to expand your library with some truly delightful new titles.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]Nora: The Wannabe Alchemist[/h3][p][b]In Nora: The Wannabe Alchemist[/b], you can fulfill your dream of becoming a true witch with the power to create a wide variety of potions! What's more, in this cozy title you can enjoy visual novel elements, take care of your enchanted garden, and decorate your hut.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1798720/Nora_The_Wannabe_Alchemist/"][/dynamiclink][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]Susan's Potion Workshop[/h3][p]Step into Susan’s world and unleash your inner witch! In [b]Susan’s Potion Workshop[/b], you open a magical potion shop and get hands-on with bubbling cauldrons, colorful elixirs, and whimsical adventures. Have fun with a "match-3" gameplay where you mix, brew, and create potions with unique effects and dazzling designs.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2661540/Susans_Potion_Workshop/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][b]See you in the laboratory![/b][/p]

notes.title: Nora is a bit late, but finally here!
notes.content:
Hi Everyone!

Nora is (as usual) being a bit of a klutz, so the game got a bit delayed due to some last-minute technical issues.

But, it's finally here and we really hope you like this alternative version of Nora's adventures!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2859820/Nora_In_Search_of_Hidden_Ingredients/

We will also try to release the latest chapter for the original Nora game sometime in early June!

notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3421340/Theres_No_Dragons/
Hi everyone!

The newest addition to our HO collection is out!

Yet again we bring 9 levels with 60 dragons to find on each of them, but this time the task will be slightly more complicated - some dragons are actually hiding behind scenery objects! Please let us know how you like this change.

notes.title: Where Logic Meets Dexterity
notes.content:
It's spring and the spring flu is all around. Hep your body to fight the nasty bacteria in our newest game - the Bacterian! Move the red blood cells on top of the nasty viruses to squish them but beware - they are definitely there to get you!

The first 10 levels of Bacterian are now available in the demo.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3570450/Bacterian/

notes.title: A New Beginning for Nora!
notes.content:
After we first announced the demo of the Nora-themed HO story we've heard people complain there's not enough substance to it and simply placing items in the game locations doesn't give enough of a game.

We've heard you, so Nora: In Search of Hidden Ingredients got her own story now, while still keeping the HO elements. And today we present you a new demo! We'll be happy to hear your opinions!

For those of you waiting on the main Nora story - we are currently working on it and will likely have something to share in 1-2 months!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2859820/Nora_In_Search_of_Hidden_Ingredients/

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44910272/2222e55459f86508394ac1dcf45206909e3ba9bb.png[/img]

notes.title: Welcome Leadlight!
notes.content:
[b]And the newest addition to our puzzle collection is out![/b]

Can you set up the pixels to create the target image? It can be more tricky than you think, since the puzzle pieces only have 3 colors, while the target images have 6 - so quite some blending is needed!


[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44910272/7ba1a8ba594d09ed6edcd1ab391f4b22ee771605.png[/img]

notes.title: Nora the Wannabe Alchemist version 0.262 - 18.06.2022
notes.content:
[h2]New features:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Clients now can be rejected (and then the new ones will show up the next day)
[*] added overlay with a proper information after reaching the current end of content
[*] added a warning sound for picking fruits/flowers with a full basket, and reviving with empty mana bar
[*] 3 tiers of achievements for gathering materials, creating the potions, planting plants, and letting plants wither
[*] 1 tier (for now) of achivements for gold earned, finished clients' orders, and used mana
[/list]

[h2]Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] ladybug and fruit collections can now be finished
[*] corrected position of tutorial labels for all the resolutions
[*] Minor Potion of Mana now can't be used before starting the harvesting minigame
[*] fixed resetting item counters in the shop
[*] other minor graphical glitches fixes
[*] minor changes in polish localization
[/list]

[h2]Balance:[/h2]
[list]
[*] shortened delay before a transformation from flower to fruit starts
[*] plants are now more responsive when it comes to reviving them
[/list]

notes.title: It’s time to become a great alchemist!
notes.content:
We’re pleased to announce that [i]Nora: The Wannabe Alchemist[/i] is [b]now available[/b] on Steam Early Access! 

Nora, an ambitious witchcraft school dropout aspires to become a great alchemist, but needs your help. For this klutzy witch, it’s going to take everything from completely cleaning her grandmother’s dusty cottage from top to bottom … to learning the art of [b]time management[/b] to truly find her place in the realm of alchemical greatness! 

We hope you enjoy it!

notes.title: Nora: The Wannabe Alchemist is a fresh time-management visual-novel hybrid
notes.content:
A mixture of point & click, time-management and a visual-novel all blended together is what you get with Nora: The Wannabe Alchemist.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2022/05/nora-the-wannabe-alchemist-is-a-fresh-time-management-visual-novel-hybrid

notes.title: Help an alchemist in training … Nora: The Wannabe Alchemist launches on May 26!
notes.content:
We have good news! [i]Nora: The Wannabe Alchemist[/i] launches here on Steam Early Access next Thursday, May 26!

Join Nora in her quest to become a famous alchemist. For a clumsy witchcraft school dropout, it’s going to take a great deal of patience and time management to make her dreams come true. Will you help?
